loaderio.about: Loader.io is a cloud-based web application load-testing service for stress-testing web applications and APIs with thousands of concurrent connections. Tests can be configured and run through the web interface or API.
features: Cloud-based load testing for web applications and APIs
Web interface and API-based test setup and execution
Test types: clients per test, clients per second, and maintain client load
Real-time test monitoring and shareable results
Target-host registration and verification
HTTP URL-sequence testing with configurable duration, client counts, timeout and error thresholds
Test-result metrics including response times, response codes, bandwidth histograms, success/errors/timeouts, and average error rate
Scheduling, callbacks, and email notifications for completed tests
loaderio.pricing: Free plan: $0/month, up to 10,000 clients per test, 1 target host, 1-minute tests, and 2 URLs per test. Pro plan: $99.95/month, up to 100,000 clients per test, unlimited target hosts, unlimited 10-minute tests, and 10 URLs per test. Paid subscriptions are month-to-month; the official signup page also shows a $99.95 monthly plan cost.

loadero.about: Loadero is a cloud-hosted web application testing platform for performance, load, WebRTC, and service-monitoring tests. It simulates real users in browsers and collects client-side, execution-time, resource-use, and WebRTC metrics.
features: Web application testing
WebRTC testing with media injection and WebRTC metrics
Performance testing
Cloud-hosted load testing with thousands or tens of thousands of concurrent users
Worldwide geographic test locations
Network-condition simulation
Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox version selection
Automated performance validations and assertions
loadero.pricing: Pricing is usage-based on compute units (one full unit equals 50% of a CPU core and 1 GB RAM). Plans shown are Essential, Ultimate, Monthly, Yearly, and Enterprise/custom. Essential: up to 20,000 compute units per test and 45-minute tests; Ultimate: up to 50,000 compute units and 2-hour tests; Monthly/Yearly: 10,000 included compute units per period, with additional usage at $0.045 per unit; Enterprise is custom-priced. Pay-as-you-go unit rates shown are $0.050 for the first 10,000 units, $0.045 for the next 10,000, and $0.0375 for the next 20,000; Ultimate rates are $0.075, $0.070, and $0.065 across the displayed tiers. A trial provides up to 100 compute units over 14 days without requiring a credit card. Prices exclude VAT. Performance-monitoring packages are separately listed at $999/month for up to 10 test cases, $1,899/month for up to 20, and $2,699/month for up to 30, plus initial setup.

k6 script-based cloud load testing

Gatling support
Selenium WebDriver performance testing
HTTP/API testing through the web UI
Multi-geographic load generation
Network simulation
Application Performance Monitoring integrations

Rounds, iterations, and multiple iteration modes for modeling realistic traffic
Cross-platform operation on Windows, Linux, and macOS
Distributed load testing using a master/worker architecture with gRPC
Real-time dashboard and live metrics
Declarative methods for random data, counters, timestamps, JSON-array sizing, and random selection
Conditional execution with skipIf
Failure criteria and termination rules based on metric expressions
